name: Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences
summary: Agricultural sciences university with main sites in Alnarp, Uppsala and Umeå; one English bachelor's, Forest and Landscape, in Alnarp.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: January round opens (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
January round closes (not for final-year IB students)
January round: documents and proof of EU/EEA citizenship due
April round opens (EU/EEA): the round for May 2027 IB candidates

April round: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
April round: final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
April round: reply to your offer or lose the place

programmes.name: Forest and Landscape (BSc)
programmes.ib: Any IB Maths course (AI SL at grade 3 is enough), plus ESS SL or two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics. The Diploma covers Civics 1b.

notes: You graduate with a BSc in either Landscape Architecture or Forestry Science, depending on the courses you complete.
You can apply, in competition, to spend the third year at Wageningen University in the Netherlands and earn a double degree.
SLU's other bachelor's are in Swedish. It urges international students to apply in January, but that is for diploma holders: as a May 2027 IB candidate you apply by 15 April (EU/EEA).
